label: My return: words

params.name: lede
params.default: {name}: drop in your documents - we read them, check them against each other and work out both tax regimes. You file the JSON on the e-filing portal.
params.label: lede

params.name: pick_lede
params.default: Whose return? Pick the person - an individual or HUF.
params.label: pick_lede

params.name: pick_none
params.default: No individual or HUF clients yet. Add one under Clients & years.
params.label: pick_none

params.name: gather_p
params.default: Start with the pre-filled JSON - it carries your details, salary, TDS and bank accounts. Then the AIS, and Form 16 from each employer. Drop them in any order; each one is read as it arrives.
params.label: gather_p

params.name: drop
params.default: Drop a document here, or choose one
params.label: drop

params.name: drop_hint
params.default: Pre-filled JSON · AIS (JSON, CSV or PDF) · Form 16 (PDF) · 26AS (text or PDF)
params.label: drop_hint

params.name: pw_ph
params.default: AIS / 26AS: your PAN in small letters + date of birth DDMMYYYY
params.label: pw_ph

params.name: ai_ok
params.default: Read Form 16 Part B with AI when its layout is unusual - the page goes to Google Gemini on this portal's key and nothing is kept there
params.label: ai_ok

params.name: k_prefill_why
params.default: Your details, salary from your employer's TDS returns, TDS, taxes paid and bank accounts - straight from the department.
params.label: k_prefill_why

params.name: k_prefill_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > Download Pre-Filled Data|Pick AY {ay} and download the JSON|Drop it here
params.label: k_prefill_how

params.name: k_ais_why
params.default: Interest, dividends, sales of shares and funds, and every TDS the department knows about.
params.label: k_ais_why

params.name: k_ais_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|Services > Annual Information Statement (AIS) > Proceed|Choose FY 2025-26, then AIS > Download (JSON or PDF)|The PDF's password is your PAN in small letters with your date of birth, e.g. abcde1234f01011990
params.label: k_ais_how

params.name: k_form16_why
params.default: Your employer's certificate: Part A (TDS by quarter) and Part B (salary, allowances, deductions). One per employer.
params.label: k_form16_why

params.name: k_form16_how
params.default: Ask your employer's HR or payroll - it is due by 15 June|Usually a signed PDF; Part A comes from TRACES|Changed jobs in the year? Bring one from each employer
params.label: k_form16_how

params.name: k_26as_why
params.default: Your tax credit as the department holds it: TDS by deductor and taxes you paid. The return is checked against it.
params.label: k_26as_why

params.name: k_26as_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Form 26AS > Confirm|Pick AY {ay}, view as Text, export|Drop the text file (or the PDF) here
params.label: k_26as_how

params.name: check_p
params.default: The same figure from two documents, side by side. A gap is not always wrong - a TDS deposited late may not show in 26AS yet - but it is better seen now than in a notice.
params.label: check_p

params.name: check_none
params.default: Nothing to compare yet - drop in Form 16 and 26AS or the AIS.
params.label: check_none

params.name: lv_amber
params.default: {a} here, not in the other document - worth a look
params.label: lv_amber

params.name: old_closed
params.default: The old regime can only be chosen in a return filed by the due date (31 July) - a belated return is under the new regime.
params.label: old_closed

params.name: verdict_same
params.default: Both regimes come to the same tax - the new regime needs nothing more from you.
params.label: verdict_same

params.name: rv_cg_p
params.default: From the AIS or your broker's capital-gains statement. Anything here other than 112A gains up to 1.25 lakh makes it an ITR-2.
params.label: rv_cg_p

params.name: rv_via_p
params.default: As your employer declared them in Form 16, or what you type. The old regime allows them all; the new only the employer's NPS (80CCD(2)).
params.label: rv_via_p

params.name: no_salary
params.default: No salary yet - drop Form 16, or add an employer.
params.label: no_salary

params.name: no_house
params.default: No house property. Add one if you own a home or let one out.
params.label: no_house

params.name: q_resident
params.default: I lived in India for 182 days or more in FY 2025-26
params.label: q_resident

params.name: q_director
params.default: I was a director of a company
params.label: q_director

params.name: q_unlisted
params.default: I held unlisted shares at some time in the year
params.label: q_unlisted

params.name: q_foreign
params.default: I have assets or income outside India
params.label: q_foreign

params.name: q_parents_senior
params.default: A parent I pay health cover for is 60 or older
params.label: q_parents_senior

params.name: q_metro
params.default: I rented in Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata or Chennai
params.label: q_metro

params.name: emp_cats
params.default: OTH=Private company or others|CGOV=Central Government|SGOV=State Government|PSU=Public sector undertaking|PE=Pensioner - Central Government|PESG=Pensioner - State Government|PEPS=Pensioner - public sector|PEO=Pensioner - others|NA=Not employed
params.label: emp_cats

params.name: states
params.default: 01=Andaman and Nicobar Islands|02=Andhra Pradesh|03=Arunachal Pradesh|04=Assam|05=Bihar|06=Chandigarh|07=Dadra and Nagar Haveli|08=Daman and Diu|09=Delhi|10=Goa|11=Gujarat|12=Haryana|13=Himachal Pradesh|14=Jammu and Kashmir|15=Karnataka|16=Kerala|17=Lakshadweep|18=Madhya Pradesh|19=Maharashtra|20=Manipur|21=Meghalaya|22=Mizoram|23=Nagaland|24=Odisha|25=Puducherry|26=Punjab|27=Rajasthan|28=Sikkim|29=Tamil Nadu|30=Tripura|31=Uttar Pradesh|32=West Bengal|33=Chhattisgarh|34=Uttarakhand|35=Jharkhand|36=Telangana|37=Ladakh
params.label: states

params.name: ready_h
params.default: Before you start: keep these handy
params.label: ready_h

params.name: ready_p
params.default: Ten minutes of gathering saves an hour of guessing. Each one you drop in below ticks itself; tick the rest as you have them.
params.label: ready_p

params.name: k_filed_why
params.default: Already filed? Drop in the JSON you filed and every figure is set beside this one.
params.label: k_filed_why

params.name: k_filed_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns|Pick AY {ay} and download the JSON (or keep the one you uploaded)|Drop it here
params.label: k_filed_how

params.name: no_filed
params.default: No filed return in this one yet - drop in the JSON you filed.
params.label: no_filed

params.name: filed_p
params.default: Give the day you filed - the dates, the late fee, interest and the regime are then worked out as of that day.
params.label: filed_p

params.name: cmp_h
params.default: Compared with the return you filed
params.label: cmp_h

params.name: cmp_p
params.default: {file}: {filed} as filed, {ours} as made here. A gap means one of the two has a figure the other does not.
params.label: cmp_p

params.name: cmp_same
params.default: Every figure agrees with the return you filed.
params.label: cmp_same

params.name: why_simple
params.default: ITR-1 (Sahaj) fits: resident, income up to 50 lakh, salary, up to two houses and other sources.
params.label: why_simple

params.name: why_nonres
params.default: ITR-2, because you were not resident in India this year.
params.label: why_nonres

params.name: why_income
params.default: ITR-2, because your total income is above 50 lakh.
params.label: why_income

params.name: why_houses
params.default: ITR-2, because you have more than two house properties.
params.label: why_houses

params.name: why_cg
params.default: ITR-2, because of capital gains beyond 112A gains of 1.25 lakh.
params.label: why_cg

params.name: why_agri
params.default: ITR-2, because agricultural income is above 5,000.
params.label: why_agri

params.name: why_director
params.default: ITR-2, because you were a company director or held unlisted shares.
params.label: why_director

params.name: why_foreign
params.default: ITR-2, because of assets or income outside India.
params.label: why_foreign

params.name: why_other
params.default: ITR-2, because of losses carried forward or income ITR-1 does not take.
params.label: why_other

params.name: schema_ok
params.default: Checked against the department's own schema ({schema}) - it fits.
params.label: schema_ok

params.name: schema_bad
params.default: {n} {n:thing|things} to fill before it fits the department's schema:
params.label: schema_bad

params.name: upload_steps
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > File Income Tax Return|AY 2026-27 · Online · your status · the form shown here|Choose 'Upload JSON' (or open it in the department's offline utility) and pick this file|Check the pages, pay any tax due first, then submit|e-Verify with Aadhaar OTP within 30 days
params.label: upload_steps

params.name: file_note
params.default: SimplyFile prepares the return; you file it yourself on the e-filing portal. Keep the documents you used - the department may ask for them.
params.label: file_note

params.name: bad_ext
params.default: That kind of file is not read here - send {exts}.
params.label: bad_ext

params.name: no_doc
params.default: That document is not in this return.
params.label: no_doc

params.name: bad_field
params.default: That field ({field}) is not one this return keeps.
params.label: bad_field

params.name: unknown_doc
params.default: This does not look like a pre-filled JSON, AIS, Form 16 or 26AS. Send one of those.
params.label: unknown_doc

params.name: need_password
params.default: This PDF is locked - type its password above and send it again.
params.label: need_password

params.name: bad_password
params.default: That password does not open this PDF.
params.label: bad_password

params.name: scanned
params.default: This PDF has no text layer (a scan or photo). Tick 'Read with AI' to read it, or type the figures under Review.
params.label: scanned

params.name: ai_failed
params.default: The AI could not read it ({why}). Type the figures under Review.
params.label: ai_failed

params.name: no_ai_key
params.default: No AI key is set up on this portal, so only the usual layouts are read. Type the rest under Review.
params.label: no_ai_key

params.name: ay_mismatch
params.default: This document is for AY {theirs}, not AY {ours}.
params.label: ay_mismatch

params.name: pan_mismatch
params.default: This document is for PAN {theirs}, not {ours}.
params.label: pan_mismatch
